purpose: Provenance of src/Rasa.Game/Data/KillRewardRules.cs and KillRewardManager. KillRewardTests reproduces every clean observation below from the rules.

sources.gameconstants: trpython.zip:shared/gameconstants.pyo (1.16.5.0): BASE_KILL_XP 62.5, STREAK_BASE_PER_PARTY_MEMBER 3, STREAK_LEVEL_BASIS 10, STREAK_MAX_VALUE 5, MAX_KILLING_STREAK_PRESTIGE_POINT_BONUS 1, XP_MOD_PER_PARTY_MEMBER 0.08, XP_MOD_FOR_GROUP 1.0, DANGER_PENALTY_LEVELDIFF_MIN 5, DANGER_PENALTY_LEVELDIFF_MAX 9, KILL_CREDIT_PRESTIGE_LEVEL_MAX_ABOVE 4, KILL_CREDIT_PRESTIGE_LEVEL_MAX_BELOW 8, MIN_DISTANCE_FOR_KILL_CREDIT 100, BASE_CRITICAL_CHANCE 5
sources.xpinfo: trpython.zip:shared/xpinfo.pyo: tuple (total, gained, baseGained, groupMod, streakMod, boosterMod, wasCritKill, wasTeamCritKill); ApplyModifier sets gained = int(gained * mod)
sources.manifestation: trpython.zip:client/augmentations/manifestation.pyo Recv_ExperienceChanged composes 'You gained %(xp)s experience points.' plus ' [%(base)s Base XP]' and ' (+%(streakMod)s%% Kill Streak Bonus)' when streakMod > 1
sources.clientmethod: trpython.zip:client/clientmethod.pyo Recv_SetKillStreak(count); Recv_GotLoot(creatureEntityId, items, moneyAmount) prints PM 262 'You received %(amount)s credits.'
sources.footage: research/20260913-bootcamp/footage/analysis transcripts (7Lrst9SG3pk A, 8VXeKzGUv0c B: final week; Ycxm8Pa1-v4 C: pre-D16.5, used only as corroboration)

rules.value: base10 = 625 + 42*L + 2*L^2 (i.e. 62.5 + 4.2*L + 0.2*L^2), L = creature level; gained = floor(base10 * streakMod / 10); baseGained = floor(base10 / 10)
rules.reasoning: Two coefficients fit ten integer constraints across levels 1-9, including four streak-doubled values that only fit if the modifier is applied before truncation. Valid range observed: creature levels 1-9 with player levels 2-10; higher levels are an extrapolation.

rules.value: 5 * L credits at the kill, announced by GotLoot with no items
citations: A3-081 and B1-018: the credit line arrives with the experience line, not at corpse looting

rules.value: the streak rises one step per 3 kills (solo), streakMod = 1 + step
citations: A4: kills at 391.5 and 396.1 plain, 401.5 max streak (+100%)
levels 2, 3, 5 and 8 reach 'max kill streak' at +100% (A4-10, B1-041, B3-028, B3-035); level 10 shows +100% (B3-060)

rules.value: 1 prestige point, PM 10000134, once per streak when the max step is reached, before the experience line

citations: A4-18 streak kill 12.5 s after A4-16
A4-28 plain kill 16.1 s after A4-18
rules.reasoning: bounded to (12.5, 16.1] s by final-week footage; 15 s chosen inside the bound

observations.note: pre-D16.5 corroboration; B1-037 final week also 66 / 5
Thrax Infantry Trainee; level read partially (4?) and consistent with the credits
Forean Machina Mk II, level 7 partially read

unexplained.summary: Player level 10: [101 Base XP] with 40 credits. 40 credits means level 8 (base 108), so a level-difference modifier (player 2 levels above) or a different credit source is involved. Not modelled.
Plain 17, 33 and 35 experience with no credits: exactly one half or one quarter of the level 1/2 base. Probably shared-damage or ally kill credit. Not modelled.
Crit kills add a separate 'by Crit Killing' line equal to the base. Kill-shot criticals are not modelled.
Pre-D16.5: a streak-annotated line whose gain equals its base. Not reproduced.

gaps.summary: No squad experience modifiers or sharing (XP_MOD_PER_PARTY_MEMBER 0.08, MIN_DISTANCE_FOR_KILL_CREDIT 100).
No partial kill credit for kills shared with allies.
Corpse items remain the emulator placeholder roll.
